Query:

 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/e2c07b0bec4fb7e278838a766aa78f64366b77893d7279f9d9c82fa6a6aa027d/97d41003-bfe1-47e0-9aa4-7cc76a2f865b/'
